definitions.explanation: Describes something intended for one's own use, as opposed to gifts, sharing, or official purposes. Commonly used when shopping or allocating items.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自分用|じぶんよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
{自分用|じぶんよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧にくくて⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: These are notes for my own use, so it's fine if they're hard to read.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{自分用|じぶんよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦チョコレート→チョコレート：05183_chokoreeto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧きた。
examples.english: Apart from souvenirs, I also bought some chocolate for myself.

notes:
{自分用|じぶんよう} means "for one's own use" or "for personal use." Especially common when distinguishing personal purchases from gifts or shared items.

FORMS:
⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧ (oneself) + ⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ (for the use of). The suffix ～⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ is productive and attaches to nouns.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {自分用|じぶんよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy for oneself
- {自分用|じぶんよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧: notes for personal use
- ⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{自分用|じぶんよう}: for myself, separate from souvenirs
Used as a no-adjective: {自分用|じぶんよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧ (a computer for personal use).

RELATED ～{用|よう} COMPOUNDS:
- {子供用|こどもよう}: for children
- {大人用|おとなよう}: for adults
- {仕事用|しごとよう}: for work
- {来客用|らいきゃくよう}: for guests
- ⟦{業務用|ぎょうむよう}→業務用：13148_gyoumuyou⟧: for commercial/business use
- ⟦{個人用|こじんよう}→個人用：26704_kojinyou⟧: for personal use (more formal than {自分用|じぶんよう})
